test_title: PYST 49: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 07 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: The question of protacting folklore was less urgent.
The question of protecting foklore was less urgent.
The question of protecting folklore was less urgent.
The question of protecting folklore was les urgent.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**protecting**" is spelled correctly in Option 3.
 
• The word "**folklore**" is also spelled correctly in Option 3, unlike in Option 2 ("foklore").
 
• All other options contain spelling errors.
 
• Therefore, Option 3 is the only sentence with no spelling errors.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** Contains a spelling error ("protacting" instead of "protecting").
 
• **Option 2:** Contains a spelling error ("foklore" instead of "folklore").
 
• **Option 4:** Contains a spelling error ("les" instead of "less").
